title: 第1614章 天枢城遇韩风第1613章 进入中洲
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
雪瑶没有再追问，目光李天身上收回来，重新落在李天身上：“天书画卷的事，不要告诉任何人。中洲不比四大洲，这里的人对宝物的嗅觉更敏锐。”
李天点了点头：“我知道。”
他没有再多说，转身望向远处的地平线。
李天收回目光，沉默了片刻后开口：“那这道屏障是谁设的？”
雪瑶说：“据说是武神殿设的，但源头可以追溯到上古时期的联盟城。联盟城覆灭后，武神殿接管了这道屏障的维护和运转。”
李天没有立刻接话，他站在岩石上，望着中洲方向那片更加开阔的天地，然后开口：“联盟城……武神殿……这道屏障拦住的不只是四大洲的人。”
雪瑶没有接话，像是已经知道他想说什么。
李天继续说：“它拦住的是神祖境以上的人。中洲的人到了神祖境之后出不去，四大洲的人到了神祖境之后进不来。”
他顿了顿，“那这道屏障真正拦住的，是武神殿不想让出去的东西。”
雪瑶没有否认，也没有肯定，只是说：“这些事你现在知道得再多也没有用。等你到了中洲腹地，自然会慢慢明白。”
李天没有再问，他从岩石上跃下，朝南面走去。
雪瑶跟在他身后，步伐不急不慢。
两人走了约莫半炷香的时间，前方的地貌开始变得更加开阔，脚下的路也变得平整起来，像是经常有人行走。
脚下的路从碎石逐渐变成了被反复踩实的土路。
雪瑶走在他身侧，目光扫过前方的路：“这条路是通往天枢城的路。”
李天没有问什么，目光落在前方那道正在缓慢变亮的线路上——雪瑶也跟上了他的步伐。
又走了约莫半个时辰，前方的视线豁然开朗。
土路延伸向一片开阔的平原，平原上零星散落着几座农舍和低矮的土墙。
远处的地平线上，隐约能看到一座城池的轮廓，灰白色的城墙在晨光中泛着微光。
雪瑶的目光也落在那个方向：“天枢城快到了。进了城之后，先找地方住下，再去办身份令牌。”

李天点了点头，没有多问。
两人沿着土路继续向前走去，脚下的路更加平整。
晨光越来越亮，城墙的轮廓也越来越清晰。
那座城池正从地平线上缓慢升起，把自己灰白色的外墙一层层地展现在晨光中。
他们在城外三里处停下脚步，没有直接飞入城中。
雪瑶看了他一眼：“进城需要身份令牌，我身上有中洲的身份令牌，但给你准备了另一枚。”
她取出一枚令牌递给他——暗青色，巴掌大小，表面刻着几道细密的纹路，“先用这个。天枢城的管理不算太严，但入城时会被检查，有令牌就能过。”
李天接过令牌，看了一眼，收入储物戒指。
两人沿着入城的土路走向城门，混在进城的散修和商队中，朝城门方向走去。
城门口站着几名穿着黑色甲胄的守卫，正在逐一检查入城者的令牌。
轮到李天时，守卫接过令牌翻看了一下，又抬头看了他一眼，然后递回来：“进去吧。”
李天接过令牌，迈步跨过城门。
脚下的青石路面比城外更加平整，两侧的店铺已经开始营业了。
他站在城门内侧，目光扫过街道两侧的店铺和行人，停了一下，然后朝前走去。
他穿过城门时，听到身后传来一阵急促的脚步声，紧接着一道声音传来：“雪瑶姐？”
他停下脚步，转过身。
一个身穿灰白长袍的年轻人站在几步外，约莫二十出头，腰间挂着一枚刻有“韩”字的玉佩，正看着雪瑶，目光带着惊喜和不确定。
他快步走上前：“雪瑶姐，真是你！你怎么回来了？”
content_en:
Xueyao didn't ask any more questions, and looked away from Li Tian, then fell on Li Tian again: "Don't tell anyone about the Heavenly Book and Picture Scroll. Central Continent is no better than the Four Continents, the people here have a keener sense of smell for treasures."
Li Tian nodded: "I know."
He said no more and turned to look at the distant horizon.
Li Tian withdrew his gaze and spoke after a moment of silence: "Then who set up this barrier?"
Xue Yao said: "It is said that it was set up by the Martial God God, but the source can be traced back to the Alliance City in ancient times. After the destruction of the Alliance City, the Martial God God took over the maintenance and operation of this barrier."
Li Tian did not answer immediately. He stood on the rock, looked at the more open world in the direction of Central Continent, and then said: "Alliance City... Martial Temple... this barrier stops not only people from the four continents."
Xueyao didn't answer, as if she already knew what he wanted to say.
Li Tian continued: "It blocks people above the Divine Ancestor Realm. People from Central Continent cannot get out after reaching the Divine Ancestor Realm, and people from the Four Continents cannot enter after reaching the Divine Ancestor Realm."
He paused, "Then what this barrier really blocks is the things that the Martial God Temple doesn't want to let out."
Xue Yao did not deny or confirm, but just said: "No matter how much you know about these things now, it is useless. When you get to the hinterland of Central Continent, you will naturally understand slowly."
Li Tian didn't ask any more questions. He jumped off the rock and walked towards the south.
Xueyao followed behind him, her pace was neither hasty nor slow.
The two of them walked for about half a stick of incense, and the landscape ahead began to become more open, and the road under their feet also became smooth, as if people were walking on it frequently.
The road beneath our feet gradually changed from gravel to dirt that had been stepped on repeatedly.
Xue Yao walked beside him and glanced at the road ahead: "This road is the road to Tianshu City."
Li Tian didn't ask anything, his eyes fell on the slowly brightening line in front of him - Xue Yao also followed his pace.
After walking for about half an hour, the view ahead suddenly became clear.
The dirt road leads to an open plain, dotted with a few farmhouses and low earthen walls.
On the distant horizon, the outline of a city can be vaguely seen, and the gray-white city walls shimmer in the morning light.
Xue Yao's eyes also fell in that direction: "Tianshu City is almost here. After entering the city, first find a place to stay, and then go get the identity token."
Li Tian nodded and didn't ask any more questions.
The two of them continued walking along the dirt road, and the road under their feet became smoother.
The morning light is getting brighter and brighter, and the outline of the city wall is getting clearer and clearer.
The city was rising slowly from the horizon, revealing its gray-white outer walls layer by layer in the morning light.
They stopped three miles outside the city and did not fly directly into the city.
Xue Yao glanced at him: "You need an identity token to enter the city. I have Zhongzhou's identity token with me, but I've prepared another one for you."
She took out a token and handed it to him - dark blue, palm-sized, with several fine lines carved on the surface, "Use this first. The management of Tianshu City is not too strict, but you will be inspected when you enter the city. You can pass with the token."
Li Tian took the token, took a look at it, and put it into the storage ring.
The two of them walked along the dirt road into the city towards the city gate, mixed in with the casual cultivators and caravans entering the city, and walked towards the city gate.
There were several guards in black armor standing at the city gate, checking the tokens of those who entered the city one by one.
When it was Li Tian's turn, the guard took the token, looked at it, looked up at him again, and then handed it back: "Go in."
Li Tian took the token and stepped across the city gate.
The bluestone pavement underfoot is smoother than outside the city, and the shops on both sides are already open for business.
He stood inside the city gate, glanced at the shops and pedestrians on both sides of the street, paused, and then walked forward.
When he passed through the city gate, he heard a rush of footsteps behind him, and then a voice came: "Sister Xueyao?"
He stoppedStep, turn around.
A young man in gray and white robes stood a few steps away, probably in his early twenties, with a jade pendant engraved with the word "Han" hanging on his waist. He was looking at Xue Yao with surprise and uncertainty in his eyes.
He walked forward quickly: "Sister Xueyao, it's really you! Why are you back?"
